meta.title: Gujarat PG Medical Admission 2026-27 (MD/MS/Diploma)
meta.authority: Admission Committee for Professional Post-Graduate Medical Educational Courses (ACPPGMEC), Government of Gujarat, Gandhinagar

process.title: Buy a PIN online
process.description: Buy the registration PIN on medadmgujarat.org for ₹28,000: ₹3,000 non-refundable registration fee plus a ₹25,000 refundable security deposit.

process.title: Register and upload documents
process.description: Enter the PIN serial number, 14-digit PIN, email, mobile and NEET roll number, then fill your details, set a password (6–12 characters) and upload documents as PDF, JPG or PNG. After you click Confirm, you can only change details at the help centre.

process.title: Book a help centre appointment
process.description: When you print your registration slip, pick the date, time and help centre for document verification.

process.title: Verify documents at the help centre
process.description: Bring the printed registration details signed by you and a parent or guardian, all originals and one self-attested photocopy set. The officer stamps your registration slip. Without it you can't continue in the admission process.

process.title: Merit list is published
process.description: ACPPGMEC publishes the merit list of eligible candidates. Check your merit number and category against your registration details.

process.title: Fill choices and get your allotment
process.description: Choice filling opens online for each round. After it closes, allotments are published and you can see yours by logging in.

process.title: Pay tuition fees
process.description: Pay the tuition fee in cash or by demand draft at a designated Axis Bank branch, or online, within the time limit.

process.title: Submit originals to confirm admission
process.description: Take your allotment letter, fee receipt (one term, i.e. 6 months) and original documents to the help centre to confirm admission.

listedHomeInstitutions.label: Institutions in Gujarat not established under a Gujarat state law
listedHomeInstitutions.note: Interpretation: eligibility route 1 needs MBBS from a university established under a law of the Government of Gujarat. AIIMS Rajkot is a central institution, so its graduates are treated like out-of-state graduates here. Confirm before publishing.

inServiceLabel.label: In-service doctor of the Government of Gujarat (needs NOC from a Gujarat competent authority)

rules.title: Qualified in NEET-PG 2026
rules.explanation: You must have qualified NEET-PG 2026 and be eligible under National Medical Commission rules and Gujarat's admission rules.

rules.title: Internship by 30 September 2026
rules.explanation: Your compulsory rotating internship must be completed on or before 30/09/2026.

rules.title: MDS isn't part of this notice
rules.explanation: The 2026-27 registration advertisement covers MD/MS/Diploma only. Watch medadmgujarat.org for an MDS notice.

rules.title: MBBS from a Gujarat university
rules.explanation: Candidates who completed a recognised MBBS from a university established under a law of the Government of Gujarat, located in Gujarat, are eligible.

rules.title: MBBS outside Gujarat, with Gujarat roots
rules.explanation: If you did MBBS outside Gujarat or abroad, you're eligible if you passed 12th (B or AB group) from a school located in Gujarat, under the Gujarat Board, CBSE, CISCE, IB/Cambridge or NIOS, and were born in Gujarat or are domiciled there.

rules.title: MBBS outside Gujarat without Gujarat schooling and birth/domicile
rules.explanation: Candidates who did MBBS outside Gujarat don't meet the eligibility criteria unless they did 12th in Gujarat and were born in or are domiciled in Gujarat.

rules.title: NRI quota is still open to you
rules.explanation: You don't meet the Government and Management quota criteria, but NRI quota eligibility doesn't depend on where you studied. You (or your parents) must be NRI, with internship completed by 30/09/2026.

rules.title: NRI quota applicants
rules.explanation: For NRI seats, you or your parents (or a legal guardian, if parents are absent) must be NRIs. Pay a ₹25,000 non-refundable processing fee by demand draft. Verification happens only at the ACPPGMEC office, GMERS Medical College, Gandhinagar.

rules.title: Proof of Indian citizenship
rules.explanation: The document list asks for proof of Indian citizenship, plus a passport copy if your citizenship is dual or foreign. Foreign and OCI candidates should check whether they qualify under the NRI quota.

rules.title: Already admitted to a PG course
rules.explanation: A candidate who secured admission in any year can't be admitted again until the period of that course would have been completed (Rule 4(4)).

rules.title: In-service doctors: 10% of seats in 10 subjects
rules.explanation: 10% of Government quota PG seats in Government and GMERS medical colleges (and CPS courses in Government hospitals) are for Gujarat in-service doctors, in Paediatrics, TB & Chest, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Preventive & Community Medicine, Orthopaedics, General Surgery, General Medicine, Anaesthesiology, Radiology and Pathology. You need an NOC from a Gujarat competent authority.

rules.title: Reserved category: Gujarat certificates only
rules.explanation: SC, ST, SEBC and EWS claims need certificates issued by competent authorities of Gujarat State only. Certificates from another state aren't listed as accepted.
rules.note: The 2026 documents don't say outright that other-state candidates count as Open. Flagged as a warning, not a category change.

rules.title: PwD: assessment by the ACPUGMEC medical board
rules.explanation: PwD applicants must be examined by an ACPUGMEC medical board at one of the listed civil hospitals. Certificates from any other authority or hospital aren't accepted. Under the NMC 2026 guidelines, the benchmark disability must be at least 40%, and the certificate also assesses functional eligibility for the course.

rules.title: Foreign medical graduates
rules.explanation: Upload your NBE screening exam (FMGE) marksheet during registration, and verify the original at the help centre.

rules.title: MBBS/FMGE aggregate is verified
rules.explanation: If your MBBS or FMGE aggregate was used to break a NEET-PG 2026 rank tie, it is checked against your originals at admission. If what you entered was wrong, your NEET-PG 2026 candidature is cancelled.

rules.title: All quotas are filled by the committee
rules.detail: ACPPGMEC fills 100% of MD/MS/Diploma seats in Gujarat, across Government (GQ), Management (MQ) and NRI (NQ) quotas, online and on merit.

rules.title: Gujarat-issued category certificates only
rules.detail: SC, ST and SEBC caste certificates, the SEBC non-creamy layer certificate and the EWS certificate must be issued by competent authorities of Gujarat State.

rules.title: Certificate issue dates
rules.detail: Non-creamy layer (Parishishta 4) and EWS certificates in Gujarati must be issued on or after 01/04/2024. English certificates must be issued on or after 01/04/2026. Both must be valid for 2026-27.

rules.title: 10% in-service seats
rules.detail: 10% of Government quota seats in 10 MD/MS subjects at Government and GMERS colleges are reserved for Gujarat in-service doctors.

rules.title: PwD certificate only from ACPUGMEC boards
rules.detail: PwD seats need a certificate from an ACPUGMEC medical board. If the board finds you unfit, you can appeal to the medical appeal board at B. J. Medical College, Ahmedabad.

registration.covers: Paid with the PIN on medadmgujarat.org (₹28,000 total with the deposit). The 2026 documents don't say whether later rounds need fresh registration.

rules.title: NRI processing fee
rules.detail: NRI applicants also pay a ₹25,000 non-refundable processing fee by demand draft in favour of “ACPUGMEC”, payable at Gandhinagar, at the ACPPGMEC office.

rules.title: Lost PIN costs ₹500
rules.detail: Keep your PIN until admission and refunds are over. To regenerate a lost PIN, visit CCR, GMERS Medical College, Gandhinagar and pay ₹500.

rules.title: Pay tuition on time
rules.detail: Pay tuition by cash or DD at a designated Axis Bank branch, or online, within the deadline. For admission you need a receipt for one term (6 months) of fees.

choiceFilling.title: Choice filling opens each round
choiceFilling.detail: After the merit list, choice filling opens online for each round. Allotments are published after the window closes.

choiceFilling.title: Check your merit number and category
choiceFilling.detail: Make sure the merit number and category on the merit list match your registration details.

choiceFilling.title: Guard your PIN and password
choiceFilling.detail: Don't share your PIN or password. Store your ID, password and PIN in several places, not only on your phone.

rounds.title: See your allotment in your login
rounds.detail: Allotment status is shown on the website. Log in with your user ID to see yours.

documents.name: Printed registration details, signed by you and a parent or guardian
All MBBS marksheets, year- and attempt-wise
Provisional (fresh graduates) or permanent medical council registration
School leaving or transfer certificate
documents.detail: Compulsory for everyone. Add a birth certificate or passport if your place of birth isn't on it.

documents.name: Caste certificate from a Gujarat competent authority
Non-creamy layer certificate (Parishishta 4)
documents.detail: Gujarati: issued on or after 01/04/2024. English: issued on or after 01/04/2026. Valid for 2026-27.

documents.name: EWS certificate from a Gujarat competent authority
documents.detail: Gujarati: issued on or after 01/04/2024. English: issued on or after 01/04/2026. Valid for 2026-27.

documents.name: Disability certificate from an ACPUGMEC medical board
12th standard marksheet
documents.detail: For candidates who did MBBS outside Gujarat.

documents.name: Gujarat domicile certificate
documents.detail: For candidates who did MBBS outside Gujarat and were born outside Gujarat.

documents.name: No Objection Certificate from a Gujarat competent authority
NRI document set (notarised colour copies)
documents.detail: ₹25,000 demand draft. Passport (all pages) of you or your NRI parent. Visa, residence permit or OCI/PIO card. NRI certificate from the Indian Embassy, High Commission or Consulate. Indian and foreign address proof. Fee undertaking on ₹300 stamp paper. Proof of origin. All documents must be in English.

documents.name: Authority letter (only if a family member verifies on your behalf)
documents.detail: Signed by you and a parent. The holder brings original photo ID.

admission.title: Originals only, no DigiLocker
admission.detail: From Round 1, help centres verify only original documents. DigiLocker documents and colour photocopies or printouts aren't accepted. Bring originals plus one self-attested photocopy set.

admission.title: Registration isn't complete until verification
admission.detail: Online registration alone isn't enough. Without verification at a help centre and a stamped registration slip, you can't continue in the admission process.

admission.title: Official updates are on medadmgujarat.org
admission.detail: All admission information is published only on the admission committee website. Check it often.
